# 1Sources

> 1Sources is a premier product sourcing and wholesale distribution company,
> combining product volume, logistics, and technology within a centralized
> platform. It connects manufacturers and wholesalers, serving wholesalers,
> retailers and e-commerce sellers across the United States from its
> headquarters at 629 Grove Street, Jersey City, NJ 07310.

Key facts:
- Founded: 20+ years of experience in wholesale distribution
- Team: 350+ specialists across sourcing, logistics and support
- Catalog: over 100,000 products
- Brands: over 900 trusted brands, including OPI, Kraft, Nestle and L'Oreal
- Clients: 1,000+; 17K+ active members; 98% client satisfaction
- Categories: Health & Beauty, Toys and Games, Grocery, Electronics, Household
- Coverage: nationwide distribution across the United States
- Contact: +1 (973) 498-8191 / hello@1sources.com
- Response time: within 48 hours

## Services

- [Product Sourcing](https://1sources.com/services/product-sourcing/): Access a vast range of top-quality products from worldwide trusted suppliers.
- [Distribution Services](https://1sources.com/services/distribution-services/): Ensuring smooth and efficient distribution with our expert logistics network.
- [Brand Finder](https://1sources.com/services/brand-finder/): Helping to identify and connect with leading manufacturers and suppliers to enhance growth.
- [Inventory Management](https://1sources.com/services/inventory-management/): Take control of your stock with our streamlined inventory management solutions.
